combo_label: Halloween × Silly English Things × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Hargreaves' blobby little fellows, taken all together as a brand
Haughty rich man of 1972, shrunk by goblins until his manners improved
Green sludge of soaked marrowfats, ladled out beside battered haddock
Said of wallpaper with far too much going on, or an eater hard to please
Blue star-shaped Hargreaves chap from chilly Coldland; one sudden red-nosed achoo
Nimble in a small hatchback, or cold enough to redden the ears
Harris variety is hand-woven in the Outer Hebrides; also a Border river
Red-suited carrier of a pitchfork, tail ending in an arrow point
Leathery night fliers, cut from black card and taped up in windows
Fruit set floating in a tub, to be caught by the teeth alone
